verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API/webhook-based banking platform with a documented REST/OpenAPI interface (openapi.json) and sandbox API-key access that can be called programmatically without a UI, implying headless usability. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, SDKs, automation examples, or scripted test pipelines for AI-native/automated workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or automation-pipeline guidance, SDK/CLI tooling for scripted use, examples of headless test automation against sandbox.
